content.text: [Feishu Group #contract-review jessica.lin GC Thu Jan 30 09:00 UTC 2026] FINAL UPDATE: VendorX has agreed to our terms. The v2.5 is the FINAL governing version. Please review and confirm your deliverables are aligned with v2.5.
